text.text:
We had a wonderful stay at the Grand Bohemian Orlando, Autograph Collection in downtown Orlando! From the moment we arrived, the service was outstanding—every staff member was attentive, responsive, and genuinely welcoming. They even went out of their way to add special touches for our anniversary, which made the stay feel extra memorable.

Dinner at The Boheme Restaurant was a highlight. The food was absolutely delicious and beautifully presented, and the service was just as impressive. It was the perfect spot for a special evening.

The hotel itself is stunning, with beautiful art and décor throughout that gives it a truly upscale and unique atmosphere. Our room was spotless, the bed was incredibly comfortable, and everything felt polished and well maintained.

Another big plus is the location—it's just a short walk to the Dr. Phillips Center for the Performing Arts, which made it incredibly convenient for a night out.

Overall, the Grand Bohemian Orlando, Autograph Collection delivers the perfect combination of luxury, comfort, and exceptional hospitality. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting downtown Orlando.

text.text:
We checked into Grand Bohemian Hotel m quite spontaneously after another nearby hotel turned out to be far too noisy—and it was the perfect decision.

Although only slightly more expensive (and also part of Marriott Bonvoy), the difference in quality was huge. Located just one block away and right in downtown, the hotel immediately impressed us. From the start, the valet team stood out—super fast, extremely friendly and consistently helpful at any time of day or night. The front desk staff were just as welcoming and made sure we got a very quiet room on the 15th floor with a beautiful view over Orlando, which we really appreciated.

Both the lobby and rooms are very stylish, with a slightly European touch. Our room was spacious, featuring a large bedroom, a little living area and great city views. The bathroom was modern with a walk-in shower.

The hotel also offers a well-equipped gym and a nice pool area on the 6th floor with a pool bar—perfect for a relaxing break. The bar itself is also very elegant. Breakfast was another highlight: great quality, fair pricing and excellent service.

Overall, a fantastic stay—we would highly recommend this hotel and would definitely come back.

text.text: I was deciding between several different hotels for a concert at Kia Center and I really lucked out deciding on the Aloft. It's really easy to get to from I-4. Exit 83 dumps out right in front of the hotel, you take the 1st right and valet parking is immediately on the right. Great for someone like me who is terrified of missing the entrance. Valet guys are great - quick and professional. The staff was top-notch and went out of their way. When I arrived after a 7-hour drive they gave me a bag of cookies and a water to revive myself. The room was clean and comfortable, the shower wonderful. I thought the towels were a little scratchy, but no big deal. If going to the Kia Center, I HIGHLY recommend the Aloft or at least one of the adjacent hotels. There are tons of restaurants within walking distance and it's a very short walk to the arena. Don't save a few dollars and stay farther away and have to find a ride among the thousands of concertgoers after the show. Trust me!

displayName.text: AC Hotel Orlando Downtown

text.text:
My recent stay was extremely disappointing and far below expectations, especially given the cost.

I paid $750 for three nights, plus a $150 per night deposit ($450 total), and $30 per night for valet. That brought my total to $1,290. I was also informed that it would take up to 7 days for the $150 per night deposit to be returned to my card. For a hotel charging these rates, the overall experience did not justify the price.

First, the room itself was not properly cleaned. The floors were visibly not well maintained. There was no microwave, no snacks available, and the only complimentary item provided was a single miniature bottle of water. Basic conveniences that are standard at many hotels were missing.

The hand shower in the bathroom was also defective — it sprayed water out of the side of the wand, making it difficult to use properly. These issues reflect poor maintenance and lack of attention to detail.

The most serious issue occurred on the morning of my departure. Despite being ready on time for my flight, I was told my car key had been misplaced and would need to be retrieved from another location, causing a delay. While I was standing outside under extreme stress, the valet manager eventually clarified that he actually had my key the entire time. The delay was caused by internal miscommunication, not a lost key.

To make matters worse, when I raised concerns to security and the front desk, I was told that if I missed my flight, the hotel would not compensate me. That response demonstrated a complete lack of accountability and concern for the situation their staff created.

Although I narrowly made my flight, the experience was unnecessarily stressful and entirely avoidable. The combination of poor communication, lack of cleanliness, maintenance issues, high charges, delayed deposit return, and dismissive responses from staff made this stay feel significantly overrated.

The Skybar was nice, but it did not come close to offsetting the overall inconvenience and service failures.

For the price paid, I expected professionalism, organization, and properly maintained accommodations. Instead, I left feeling frustrated and disappointed. I strongly encourage management to review these issues seriously and address the clear breakdowns in service and communication.

text.text:
Great hotel, beautiful rooms, but extremely loud traffic noise. I wasn’t sure how many stars to give for the provided categories.

I stayed at this hotel for one night and overall it was a very nice experience in terms of comfort, service provided,  and atmosphere. The room itself was lovely—clean, modern, and well-designed. The bar on the 18th floor was also a highlight, with a fantastic view and a great place to unwind.

However, my biggest complaint was the traffic noise. I have stayed in hotels near major highways before, but none have been as loud as this one. The sound coming from outside was constant and made it very difficult to sleep.

To the hotel’s credit, they did provide a noise machine and earplugs, which was a thoughtful touch, but unfortunately neither helped much.

I’m not sure if there are rooms on another side of the hotel that don’t face the traffic, but if you plan to stay here, I strongly recommend requesting a room away from the road. The hotel itself is lovely, but the noise level was a major issue for me.

Check-in was smooth and pleasant, and the food at the hotel was great. Overall, the front desk staff and the hotel itself were nice and welcoming.

However, I had a serious issue during my stay that made me feel very uncomfortable and unsafe. After we had just gotten out of the shower, a maintenance worker opened our hotel room door. The only thing that prevented him from coming fully inside was the safety lock we had in place.

He remained outside our door for a while and was very persistent, even though I clearly told him we did not request maintenance or call for any service. He didn’t speak much English (only Spanish), and the interaction felt uncomfortable because he wouldn’t leave until my significant other called the front desk. About 10 minutes later he left without saying anything or apologizing.

Unfortunately, the same thing happened again the next morning, twice.

That said, once the hotel manager Josh got involved, he was more than accommodating. He took the situation seriously, explained what happened, and apologized multiple times. I genuinely appreciated his professionalism and how he handled everything.

I’m leaving this review because I believe the hotel needs to tighten safety procedures around room entry to make sure this never happens to another guest.

text.text:
I do not write reviews lightly, but I feel obligated to share this experience due to significant safety and cleanliness concerns.

My fiancé and I stayed here while attending a ceremony honoring my late father for being recognized as an organ donor. We needed a safe and comfortable place during an already emotional weekend. Unfortunately, that was not our experience.

Check-In & First Impressions
The check-in process was unprofessional and uncomfortable. The front desk associate provided no information about the property or how to locate our room. No credit card was requested for incidentals despite the reservation being prepaid through Expedia. When asking about my fiancé staying in the room, he awkwardly requested his full name without explanation, which felt unnecessary and poorly handled.

The lobby restrooms were closed to the public, and used napkins remained on the entrance table for nearly two days. The elevator (there is only one) had a strong odor and visible dust buildup.

Security & Environment Concerns
It became apparent that there are long-term residents living at this property — something not disclosed at the time of booking. There was a heavy volume of people coming and going in the hallways at various hours. Individuals appeared to be visiting rooms without any visible registration or oversight. The front desk was frequently unattended, and the lobby door was often left open, allowing unrestricted access to the building.

The second floor consistently smelled of marijuana and cigarette smoke despite posted no-smoking signs. Dogs barked regularly, and there was a lingering odor of garbage in the hallway. These conditions were not addressed during our stay.

For paying guests expecting a standard hotel environment, the lack of controlled access and visible staff presence created a genuine sense of vulnerability and concern for personal safety.

Room Conditions
The air conditioning and television functioned — those were the only positives.

The room had a noticeable pet urine odor. The bathroom contained hair that was not ours. The kitchen sink repeatedly backed up, releasing a foul smell from the drain. The window frame was broken. The bed was extremely firm and uncomfortable, and the pillows were small and unsupportive. The carpet appeared worn and questionable in cleanliness.

Given the lack of professionalism and staff presence from the start, I did not feel confident that raising concerns would result in resolution.

Transparency Matters
The photos on Expedia and Google do not accurately reflect the current condition or atmosphere of this property. When booking as part of a travel bundle, this hotel is presented as a budget-friendly and convenient option near central Florida attractions. There is no transparency indicating the presence of long-term residents or the level of security oversight.

This stay added unnecessary stress to an already difficult weekend. We left feeling disappointed, uncomfortable, and concerned about the lack of basic hotel safety standards.

I strongly encourage greater transparency so future guests can make informed decisions

If i could give them zero stars i would !

Please do not book this hotel. This was one of the worst experiences I’ve ever had, and I want to make sure others are aware before they spend their money here.

When I arrived, the outside already looked questionable, but I tried to give it the benefit of the doubt. As soon as I got to my room, guests were outside smoking weed, and the entire property looked extremely run-down. My room door looked like it had been kicked in and even had a hole in it. It took several attempts just to get it open because it was so poorly fitted.

Inside the room was even worse. There was mold on the walls, in the bathroom, and even on the artwork. The sink was cracked and broken. The bed sheets were stained yellow and had hair on them. The pillows didn’t even have pillowcases. Within the first 10 minutes, we saw over five roaches. At that point, we immediately checked out.

The front desk told us they couldn’t help us because it was nighttime and we’d have to wait until the next day for a refund. Despite leaving after less than 10 minutes, we were still charged for a full night. While checking out, several other guests were also in line asking for refunds, so it wasn’t just our room.

Do not stay here. It is unsafe, unclean, and not maintained at even a basic level.

text.text:
We stayed for two nights with our baby. The rooms are spacious, and although the hotel is older, the size of the room, kitchen, and bathroom was decent — so no complaints there. What really disappointed us was the maintenance and housekeeping.

Our bathroom became clogged the first night. We’re very reasonable people, so before even calling housekeeping we asked for a tool so we could try to unclog it ourselves. It was messy, but we did what we could and even wiped up the water with towels so it would be easier for housekeeping to finish cleaning. After reporting the issue twice, we left expecting they would at least replace the towels and sanitize the floor.

We came back later that night to find nothing had been done — no cleaning, no new towels — and the bathroom was still unusable. The next morning we didn’t even feel comfortable showering or bathing our child. When we checked out, the front desk told us housekeeping had reported the room as cleaned, which simply wasn’t true.

I understand this isn’t a luxury hotel, and I don’t expect perfection. But basic cleanliness and follow-through are the minimum, especially for families traveling with children. Unfortunately, I wouldn’t recommend staying here.

text.text:
We booked this place because of their penthouse suite offering.  We wanted two rooms as we were traveling with our parents.

The property itself is quite dated.  It’s sufficient for a quick overnight, but I wouldn’t recommend it for longer stays.

Our room had a damp smell and needed some pretty significant uplifting.  The door had peeling faux framing, the shower/tub floor was really worn and the drawer upstairs didn’t stay closed.  Also, it was barely stocked with any essentials you normally get at a Residence Inn.  We had four guests and hardly anything provided had a set of four (two forks, two wine glasses, two mugs, etc.).  There wasn’t really anything to cook with even though there was a stove.

The beds were fairly comfortable although extra pillows in the room would be nice instead of 3 total per bed.  And the breakfast was fine.  It was a typical eggs, sausage, etc available in the lobby area.  I’ve had this breakfast at many properties but it was extremely lackluster here.  The eggs had a lot of water in the pan and the sausage was shriveled like maybe it was microwaved.

Our check in was uneventful but completely unmemorable.  We did talk to a sweet guy during breakfast who worked there who was very pleasant and accommodating.

I’m also not sure why you pay $5 a night to park.  It’s their property, you’re not in a downtown area, and they don’t even ask for your car info.  So it’s not like you’re getting any sort of security from paying.

All in all, not a stop I’d recommend.  There are new properties in the vicinity where you’ll likely have a better experience.

Late post, but about a month ago I had booked an early reservation. There was some confusion at the front desk at shift change, and long story short after working almost a 17 hour shift (I travel for work, as a contractor) I show up and get told my early check in wasn’t legit. I was able to get about 5 hours of sleep before my next shift, and enjoyed the peace and quiet room. My encounter with him alone, and the professional way he went about handling this is why I’m leaving a 5 star review. And I will definitely be booking at this location again.

text.text:
I stayed at the hotel in the Presidential Suite on February 6th through the 8th. The night of the 7th, I was approached by the Bar Manager James asking me about my Service Dog. I had previously stayed at this hotel a number of times throughout 2025, so the staff knows my service dog very well. James said the GM was making a big deal about it, because my dog was wearing his vest. Well after a day out at Old Town, and then City Walk, where he had his vest on all day, I didn't feel the need to have his vest on at the hotel, where he is very well known and liked. I had never met the GM before, not sure if she was new or what. I went upstairs and retrieved his vest, then went to the lobby and requested to speak to the GM, so I could educate her on what the law is. Needless to say, as I was waiting on some customers to clear the desk, the GM came out yelling at me, asking if I had something to say, and to not talk to her daughter. When in passing, I only mentioned that he has his vest on now. She was yelling and acting very unprofessional to where I couldn't get a word in edgewise. She said that she was revoking my room and I had to be checked out by morning, even though I had another night booked. I later was spoken to by other staff, in which assured me that I was good to go, and would not have to check out and that I was most certainly welcome back. Upon finishing the job I was in town for, I went back to the hotel and decided to just leave and forfeit my night, rather than having to run into her again. I again had business here locally this weekend and again booked a room for just one night. During the course of my day, I received a call from the hotel, stating I was listed as a "Do NOT rent"! I had to call Expedia to get my room cancelled and rebooked elsewhere in which they did.
i can't say enough as to how badly I was treated at this hotel by their General Manager. Unprofessional, Rude, and Threatening. Hopefully the property owner will speak with some of the staff at the hotel, to get their opinion of her actions, and how she treats people. I got the impression that she is not very well liked by her own staff.

text.text:
My daughter stayed here for about a month, but I paid for the stay and the deposit—and the experience was extremely frustrating, especially when it came to getting my money back.

At check-in, the deposit was originally stated as $50, then changed to $100. The staff member (I believe her name was Tiffany) processed it as a purchase instead of a deposit, which caused issues later. At checkout, we were initially told there was no deposit at all—despite me having proof from my credit card and receipt.

I was then told it would take 3 days to receive my refund. After 8 days, nothing had been returned, and my bank confirmed there was no pending refund. When I reviewed the paperwork, it showed the refund had been sent to a different card that I did not use.

When I went back to the hotel, I spoke with the manager, general manager, and another staff member (Lisa). The situation was not handled professionally. I was given conflicting explanations, including being told that Booking.com had my deposit—which they confirmed was not true. Eventually, the general manager stated he corrected the error and reprocessed the refund to the correct card, but only after I had to come in person and push for answers. I did call my bank and they stated there is still no refund. I will be keeping an eye on it and will escalate it further if needed to get my refund.
I do not feel it takes 3 people attacking you to get it resolved and Lisa is not very friendly, staff talk down on you knowing there not being honest to try to convince you otherwise. That is why I was able to verify with other company’s today the information they provided was false.

** I also became aware that I am not the only customer who has had issues receiving their deposit back, which is concerning.

Beyond the billing issue:
•	The room did not match the photos advertised
•	Housekeeping was inconsistent and did not stay on top of basic cleaning
•	There were cleanliness issues during the stay, including bugs in the room
•	Key cards frequently stopped working and had to be reset multiple times

Overall, this was a stressful experience. A simple deposit return turned into multiple trips, conflicting information, and unnecessary delays. I would not recommend staying here.

Would give no stars if I could

text.text:
I recently visited Rayan Lounge for the first time and had a blast! The manager, Mr. Vibe, was incredibly friendly and professional, which really set the tone for the night.
The drinks are actually worth the money, and the food was amazing. Those wings are so good they’ll make you want to slap your mama!
The playlist was on point—a perfect mix of old-school classics and new-school beats.
Overall, the atmosphere is exactly what you want for a night out.
The Downfall:
The only major issue is the reentry/bathroom policy. I was informed at the register that if you leave the lounge area—even just to use the restroom—you have to be careful. You get one trip to the bathroom for free, but if you don't go to the specific one on the right, or if you have to go a second time, they charge an additional $5 to get back inside.
For a place that sells great drinks, a "bathroom tax" is a real damper. People drink, so people are going to need the restroom! It definitely makes you second-guess ordering that next round.
Verdict: I loved the vibe and will definitely be returning, but I’ll be mindful of that door policy next time!

There are other cleaner and cheaper hotels in the area. Hard disagree this hotel is rated 3-stars. Wish we never stayed here.

text.text: Originally had booked this hotel because of a last minute plan change. Got there and everything was fine, checking in I heard someone call and complain about the fact that the internet and TV cable wasn't working, but thought okay maybe it was just the room they were in. I proceed to go up to my room and turn the TV on, nothing (no signal) black screen. Try to connect to Wi-Fi,  also nothing. Okay, so I drive 4 hours to stay at a hotel to count ceiling tiles all night long until I fall asleep? I don't think so. I get a text from someone on property and immediately mention the fact that my TV cable and Wi-Fi aren't working, their response? Sorry our maintenance department is "working" on it but there is no ETA of when it will be back. You would think they would have the decency to send me an email before check in or have mentioned this major inconvenience upon check in? Nope NOTHING! Okay, so I grab my things and go to another hotel and as I'm driving there I immediately call Expedia since I book through them and request that my room be canceled and I get a refund. Agent then puts me on hold and calls the hotel, their answer? No they can't give me a refund because they don't have anyone to clean my room! Seriously?! I'm sorry but that doesn't sound like a reason to not give a refund to someone that has already been inconvenienced by your Wi-Fi and cable outage. Clearly they have 0 customer service or decency because I'm sure had this happened to any of them they would have been just as frustrated as I was! Thanks for nothing Hilton, I will be sure to let everyone I know to not stay at your hotel in any future dates!

text.text:
Unethical Business Practices – Stay Away
Rating: 0/5 Stars
If you value your money or your sanity, do not stay here. InTown Suites are absolute thieves.
I lived here for six months without a single issue regarding my ESA. Suddenly, they implemented a "zero tolerance" pet policy. While I understand rules change, the way they handled it was predatory. On the second day of a week I had already paid for in full, they saw my cat and kicked me out immediately.
Here is the "thievery" part: They refused to refund the remaining five days of my stay. They effectively stole hundreds of dollars for a room they wouldn't let me sleep in. Because they kept my money, I was left with no funds for another hotel and was forced to sleep in my vehicle for two days.
To make matters worse, they fought my credit card dispute with "paperwork" to justify keeping money for services they never provided. They are more than happy to take your money and throw you on the street the next day.
Avoid this place at all costs. They don't care about residents; they only care about finding excuses to keep your cash.

text.text:
Absolutely a hidden gem! Was comparing different hotels in the vicinity to the convention center and this one came as the highest rated hotel that was actually a hotel and not a motel. For the price I was absolutely blown away with how clean the rooms were, how friendly the staff was and how accommodating everybody was.

Breakfast isn't anything to write home about but it is freshly made to order, well prepared, and overall very fulfilling. On top of that, breakfast is included in your total price of the stay so you do not have to worry about carrying extra money or sitting a side extra expenses for breakfast.

The water instantly ran hot in the showers. There was no intermittent heat, no issues with water pressure, or issues with water hardness.

There's a coffee maker in my room that was very, very clean. Looking worked very quick and efficient, and overall was a very big plus for me. I would say in the future if you could add a couple of bags of green tea to your rooms that would help out a lot, I went ahead and just went to the Dollar tree around the corner and grabbed a pack of a hundred of them so no big issues there.

Housekeeping works on a bike call basis. As long as you call and request before 11:00 a.m. housekeeping will come and clean, unlike most hotels around here that work on a every 2 to 3-day schedule.

Overall, my experience was five stars, I would 100% recommend staying here to somebody else and I would 100% come back.

text.text:
It’s a you get what you paid for situation, i’m paying around 300 a week for my room. It’s not going to be the fanciest nor the most luxury hotel ever but it’ll do. Emotional support animals and service animals do stay for free and their initial pet fee is actually very low you only pay 75 for the first three nights and after that there is no pet charge. The room is a tad bit dated but there is a microwave and a mini fridge in room. Honestly from the situation i was in prior this is a lot better and im happy here. The ac is very nice it cools and gets very quickly and everything in the room works. I only rated a four because some people can be a little loud and people seem to smoke in their rooms which gives the hallway around their room the smell of cigs which i personally don’t like. There’s a person who was always laughing and talking pretty loud in their room which i could hear sometimes but aside from that it’s a nice place to stay. If you have a dog and need a cheap place to stay i would actually recommend this hotel rather then another one. It’s good for a temporary home. And contrary to other reviews i have not seen a single roach here not even a bug, and my room and sheets where actually spotless and clean. The bathroom had wear and tear in it but i’m not the only person who’s stayed here so obviously that’s bound to happen. The room is actually very cozy and i was expecting a lot worse because of the reviews and the ratings. It’s just like any regular holiday inn without the holiday inn price. In summary it’s very good if you have a pet and your on a budget along. All the reviews are lying or overdramatic but everyone’s stay is different. Clean room, No roaches, Wear and tear in the bathroom, Free breakfast isn’t anything extraordinary but it’s something to get you through the morning, it’s a very cozy hotel and close to a lot of warehouse jobs about a mile or two away so it’s a cheap uber or a short drive, good option for someone who is going through a hard time financially. You can’t expect five star luxury but this hotel is very good for its price. Just the microwave alone in the room lowered my food bills because i can heat a little something up here from the grocery store rather then going out. I really recommend this hotel and my stay here was very pleasant. I don’t usually write reviews but i just wanted people to know that this hotel has a bad rep that i don’t really agree with.

edit- went to a different hotel for a few nights after their prices racked up randomly came back like a week ago got assigned a different room the ac in this room didn’t work, and i found two bugs on my bed im writing off the bugs as they might’ve come from my suitcase that was on the floor and they didn’t look like bedbugs but who knows, icked me out a bit so if getting a room id recommend asking for third floor because rooms on first floor aren’t as good

text.text: We absolutely loved visiting this resort. It’s great for families or couples but we came as an adult weekend trip and found it extremely peaceful. The hotel design itself is gorgeous, we genuinely thought we were in the wrong place at check in. The rooms were beautiful, onsite pool was large, restaurant was delicious with many options and reasonably priced. They do have saunas & steam rooms in the separate women’s and men’s locker rooms (not coed). There are lots of quiet places to sit outdoors or in doors & near the lake. We also were told you can access JW & Ritz amenities since they share properties. We did utilize the Ritz’s mountain bikes for no charge. Overall great property & we’re looking forward to coming back.

It's hard to complain about a MVC.  The rooms were amazing, the pool, lazy river, walking path, and beautiful palms were inviting and relaxing, helping us to maximize our vaca effect.

It was a bit disheartening to see signs that it would be appreciated if we would take the sheets off the bed and throw all towels in the tub.

While we're defintely 'for' not having daily cleaning - more environmental not getting a new towel each day, we felt that this request gave the MVC a bit of a 'European Hostel' feel ... definitely not ideal for the owners.

We've tried to get into this property for years and are very happy that we finally were able to enjoy the time here.

text.text:
I am a heart attack survivor of 7 months. I am also in heart failure. I sought out this property in search of peace and solitude, but what I found instead was a monster in the gates of hell. The General Manager of this property prioritizes room inspections over providing a pleasant experience, and stay. I asked her several times to fix my TV, and she never did. Instead she came for a room inspection. I dont like strangers in my room, but I didn't mind because I'm a pretty clean and organized person. When she came in I pointed out the TV once more, and I also mentioned my recent heart attack and pointed out the meds to emphasize that I needed rest and recovery. She walked away mid sentence. Then a few days later I received a notice stating that my room was too cluttered and my service animal is a safety and health violation. WOW!!! After I confronted her about it, she then proceeded to call the Sheriff and trespass me, and she even threatened to have me arrested. She ejected me from my room, in the middle of the day. I explained that I needed time due to my physical limitations. I cannot lift more than 10 pounds. She told the Sheriff to tell me that if I wasn't gone in 1 hour, she would keep my remaining paid days, and my security deposit. She put my health at risk over a power trip.

The tub was also dirty. The walls were dirty. The housekeeper cleaned the room next door and swept the trash out into the breezeway, but she prioritized the cleanliness of my room, and my service animal. When I went to confront her about the notice, she was in the room of a very elderly man taking pictures, and telling him he needed to get someone to come and clean his room. If you are disabled this is not the property for you or your family. They will invade your privacy at will, and upon protest you will be treated with the utmost disrespect. The General Manager is a hell beast. She is the nastiest person I have ever met, and when I told her so, she had me trespassed, and risked my life to do so. STAY AWAY!!!!!

Avoid this place.

My family and I came from Jacksonville to Orlando to stay here for one week. From the very beginning at check-in, the front desk receptionist (Toyota) was extremely rude and disrespectful.

The biggest issue started immediately: for five days, we did not have the freedom to properly enter and exit our room. The door would not lock. We were forced to leave it partially closed because it would not secure properly.

Our personal belongings had to stay in the car because we were afraid someone could enter the room and steal our items. Staff came multiple times attempting to fix the door, but they never resolved the issue.

For five days, we were unable to safely leave the room to go to the grocery store or anywhere else without worrying about our belongings.

When I asked for a different room, they said none were available. When I requested a refund so I could relocate my family to another hotel, they dismissed the request and responded sarcastically: “If you want, you can check out now.”

We had just checked in.

This was extremely frustrating and unprofessional.

If you value safety and basic respect, I do not recommend staying here.

text.text:
My stay at the JW Marriott Orlando, Grande Lakes was enjoyable overall, but there was a significant issue that needs to be addressed.
The property itself is beautiful, the pool area is fantastic, and the food at the restaurants was excellent. The resort has a great atmosphere, and much of the staff we encountered were friendly and professional.
However, I was very disappointed to see non-service animals inside two of the restaurants, including sitting on the bench seating where guests dine. Under Florida law (509.233), animals are not permitted in restaurants unless they are legitimate service animals. Seeing this in a resort of this caliber was surprising and concerning.
I brought the issue to the attention of two different managers, and unfortunately both responses suggested it was not viewed as a serious concern. Respectfully, it is a serious issue. Health regulations exist for a reason, and guests should be able to dine without worrying about animals being allowed in restaurant seating areas.
Aside from this problem, the stay itself was pleasant. However, the lack of concern from management regarding compliance with restaurant health regulations was disappointing and is something the hotel should address to maintain the standards expected from a property like this.

text.text:
My first visit to The Ritz-Carlton Orlando, Grande Lakes was for a conference, so unfortunately I did not have much time to fully explore all the facilities the resort has to offer. Even so, it was easy to see why this property is regarded as one of Orlando’s premier luxury resorts.

The resort is beautifully landscaped with a relaxing atmosphere that feels far removed from the busy theme parks nearby. I was fortunate to be given a room with a balcony overlooking the pool, which provided a pleasant view and a nice spot to unwind after a full day of meetings. As a Marriott Bonvoy member, I also received vouchers for complimentary coffee and pastries each morning, which was a thoughtful touch to start the day.

Although I did not get to experience the spa, golf course, or extensive recreational facilities, I enjoyed the restaurants and bars within the resort. The staff were consistently friendly, welcoming, and attentive to my needs throughout the stay, making the experience even more enjoyable.

The only thing I felt was missing was an Executive Lounge. As a Marriott Bonvoy Titanium member, I have come to appreciate the lounge experience at many Marriott properties, and it would have been a wonderful addition to an otherwise excellent stay.

Overall, The Ritz-Carlton Orlando, Grande Lakes left a very positive impression on me. Despite being here primarily for business, I could easily see myself returning in the future for a proper resort getaway to fully enjoy everything this beautiful property has to offer.

text.text: We took a long weekend staycation for some r&r. Exemplary is the best way to describe our visit. Valet quickly unloaded our car and had our bags sent to our room. Check in was immediate and easy. The room was beautiful and equipped with an amazing coffee station and fully stocked wet bar. The bathroom had a super hot shower and tub to soak in, dual sinks and all the amenities and extra towels. Closet was very large with a top shelf and cubbies and an umbrella in case of rain. Housekeeping came by that evening to see if we needed more towels, water or something else. What a nice surprise.  I spent the next day at the spa: massage, facial and manicure. Holy cow! The technicians were very professional, kind and a lot of fun. Each treatment left me wanting more. The spa had a cafe for a lunch break. I recommend the turkey wrap and fruit plate. Best pineapple ever! The spa also had an indoor hot tub, sauna, steam room a private outdoor pool and hot tub, showers, dressing rooms and an area to blow dry your hair. The room service menu  had something for everyone and the Manhattan cocktail was off the charts. The grounds are exquisite with beautiful plants and trees and fit in so well with the impressive Spanish architecture. Our favorite was all the photographs and artwork in our room and all around the hotel.  We felt like we were in a museum. Be sure to take your time, walk around and enjoy it. I cannot recommend this hotel enough. A perfect splurge!

text.text:
My recent stay at the **The Ritz-Carlton** was exactly what you hope for when booking a luxury property — refined, seamless, and effortlessly comfortable.

From the moment I arrived, the service set the tone. The staff anticipated needs before I even had to ask. Check-in was smooth, warm, and personal without feeling overbearing. That level of attentiveness continued throughout the stay — from housekeeping to concierge — everyone operated with quiet professionalism.

The room was beautifully appointed: plush bedding, spotless finishes, and thoughtful touches that elevated the experience beyond just “nice.” The bathroom felt spa-like, with generous space and high-end amenities. You can tell they invest in maintenance and details — nothing felt worn or overlooked.

Dining on property was equally impressive. The presentation, service pacing, and ambiance matched the brand’s reputation. It’s the kind of place where you can enjoy a relaxed breakfast or an elegant evening cocktail without ever leaving the hotel.

What truly separates The Ritz-Carlton, though, is consistency. Luxury isn’t just in the décor — it’s in how they make you feel. There’s a calm, polished confidence in how everything is handled.

If you’re looking for a stay that blends sophistication, comfort, and world-class service, The Ritz-Carlton continues to deliver at the highest level.

★★★★★

text.text:
As a Bonvoy Elite member, I expect a basic level of consistency and safety when staying at a Marriott-branded property. Unfortunately, this location fell short in several areas.
First, the exterior lighting is inadequate.
The parking lot and walkways were very dark at night, and a vehicle nearly struck me while turning through the lot. This is a safety concern that should be addressed immediately.
Second, the brick walkway has tree-root upheaval, creating an obvious trip hazard. This is not minor wear and tear, it is a liability issue that needs repair.
Finally, arriving at the room to find two bottles of water placed on the desk with a sign stating $5 per bottle was disappointing and frankly insulting for an Elite member. Charging for basic bottled water especially when it is staged as if it were complimentary, reflects poorly on the brand. I seriously question who within the hospitality or brand standards group thought this was an acceptable guest experience. Owning multiple companies myself, whoever come up with that would likely be terminated.
Courtyard is positioned as a professional, business-friendly hotel. Attention to safety, maintenance, and basic guest courtesy should reflect that standard. This property has room for improvement.

I purchased a travel package through a Brazilian tour operator, including airfare and accommodation at the Garnet Inn hotel.

Upon arriving at the hotel in the early morning of December 28th (my reservation was for the 27th, but our flight was delayed and we arrived in the early morning), we were greeted by a gentleman at reception who immediately requested my credit card for expenses and tourist tax.

He took us to our reserved rooms, two rooms, as I was traveling with my husband and five children. They were in the last building and the rooms were unbearable. There was a bad smell, dirt everywhere, A LOT OF MOLD, dirty and moldy armchairs, and an unbearable smell of marijuana in the hallways.

Honestly, it was a terrible impression. Even the man who attended to us commented that he didn't want to put us in those rooms due to the conditions and offered to change our room as soon as a room became available in the buildings across the street.

Honestly, there was no way I could stay there with my children.

I immediately requested the cancellation of the reservation and a refund of the fee already charged, and he told me he would cancel it and that regarding the stay, I should request a refund from the operator because they hadn't received anything until our arrival. This hasn't happened to this day.

I kindly request that you contact me so that I can be reimbursed for the NON-ACCOMMODATION and the USD 95.88 charged to my card, which was not cancelled.

text.text:
We stayed here one night to board a cruise the next day and I’m glad it was only one.

I’ll start with the positives. The room itself was fine. The bed was comfortable and we were able to get a good night’s rest. The location is near lots of shops, restaurants, etc. so that’s a plus.

The bathroom was a different story. One of the first things we noticed upon entering the room was that the sink was dirty and there were multiple short, dark and curly hairs in it - which I can only assume to be pubes. So yeah, that was pretty off-putting. We got in late and were tired from travel, so we decided to shower in the morning. There was not a single form of a towel in our room - no hand towel, no bath towels, no washcloths, no bath mat. I have never experienced this in any hotel before (including many other Holiday Inns).

We called housekeeping requesting towels and we were told it would be 20 minutes - which we were fine with. 20 minutes pass and nothing. At 30 minutes, we called back and finally received towels about 40 minutes later. We’re understanding and patient people, but by that point it was nearing checkout time so we were scrambling a little to hurry up and both shower so we could be out as soon as possible.

The cherry on top was finding more mysterious dark curly  hairs in the shower :)

Hello,

I recently stayed at your Holiday Inn Alafaya location while in town with my partner for a bowling tournament. Overall, my stay was fine and I did not have any major complaints about the hotel itself.

However, I did want to provide some feedback regarding the service at the front desk. One of the associates I interacted with earlier in the day seemed very disengaged and unprofessional. He appeared more focused on his phone than on assisting guests. I asked him about having my room cleaned, but it did not seem to be a priority to him, and my room was never serviced as requested.

Later that evening, after returning from my tournament, I had a completely different experience with another front desk employee. His professionalism and kindness made a big difference, and I truly appreciated his effort. I was so grateful that I went out of my way to bring him a pizza as a thank-you.

I wanted to share this because employees like him are what make guests feel valued and willing to return. Unfortunately, the earlier interaction with the other associate left a poor impression and made me hesitant about staying again.

Thank you for taking the time to review my feedback. I hope you continue to have more staff members like the gentleman who assisted me that evening.

I had to keep asking for clean towels and trash removal every single day because the room was never cleaned—not even once.

To make matters worse, I found a roach in the bed, which is completely unsanitary and shocking for a hotel at this price point and under this brand. Sleeping in a room that was never cleaned, along with dealing with pests, created an uncomfortable and unhealthy environment.

Regardless of how the reservation was made, the conditions inside the room and the cleanliness of the establishment are still their responsibility. It is your hotel, your housekeeping staff, and your standards—not the third party’s.

Given the lack of service, the unsanitary conditions, and the inadequate response from management, I am requesting a full refund and hope these issues are corrected for future guests. Very disappointed Holiday Inn!

text.text:
Stayed here during a work conference. Disappointed, unlikely people recieved hospitality training.  The  room itself was clean, housekeeping did a great job.  The bathroom was dated but clean.  HOWEVER, the shower only had HOT water. My skin was red and I had to step out because it was too hot. I told the desk clerk on day one.  They sent a plumber while I was gone, who seemed to have adjusted the handle on the shower, recaulked, but there was still only hot water.  On day two, after another unbearably hot shower,  I complained again when I returned from my day and a different person at the desk asked the room #, then said "you must be in one of the rooms that the construction workers reversed the hot and cold lines.If you turn the handle all the way to hot, you will get cold water."  He was right. Shower experience was fine the rest of the stay except the shower dripped the entire time I was there. There is nothing posted about the hot/cold issue, seems like a safety issue, someone could be badly burned.  Several days into my stay, the toilet was not working.  I tried to call the desk but the phone in the room did not work.  I had to use the public restroom because the desk person said the plumber doesn't come in until 8am and "when would you like them to come to your room?".  He made a ticket to repair the phone. At no time during my stay, with these concerns, did anyone say "I'm sorry".  I could have been offered a different room.   They could have at least offered a free breakfast.  Or courtesy water. They showed no concern for my inconvenience, just another repair ticket.
I usually stay in Hilton Garden Inns, but not sure I want to do that in the future.

If I could give it less than one I would.

Do yourself a favor....avoid this place at all cost. You'll only be losing money and sleep.

text.text:
Edit 4/20/26

Since the owner wants to respond and say i demanded a free night that I threaten to leave a bad review if I didn’t get it, I attached all correspondence. I never asked for a refund, I never asked for anything other than a solution. I was told to email Amanda for any discount or refund. But I never asked for it. Take some accountability of your horribly ran hotel. I can in many hotels for all different events and never received any service like this. And you said most people know your type? So what’s that mean? My type? The type that pays for a hotel room and expects his family to be comfortable in that room.

I checked in on 4/17/2026. I arrived at the hotel around 5pm and check in went very smooth. The staff at the desk was very friendly and got me checked in quickly. When I arrived in my room 319, it was extremely warm. I went to the ac unit and it wasn’t even on. I turned it on and set it to
60 with max fan to cool the room down. We left at 6:45 to go get dinner and the room was still very warm. I asked the front desk how long does the room normally take to cool down and was told about an hour or so. Was told that a lot of rooms the ac gets turned off after guest check out and the ac takes a little bit to get going. We came back from dinner around 8:30 and the room was still extremely warm. Around 10, I called down to the front desk and complained that the room was still extremely warm
And you couldn’t feel the cool air coming out unless you sat at the unit. The lady from the desk came up and stated she would try to reset it but she wasn’t a maintenance person and couldn’t guarantee anything. She even stated it was very warm in the room when she walked in and mentioned you couldn’t feel the cool air by the beds.  I then asked about switching rooms and was told there weren’t any rooms available. I even stated I could go online a book the same room I was in and was told I couldn’t switch. When I complained about needing to talk to someone else to make more of a complaint, I was given the general managers card and was told to email her because she’s the only one who could give refunds or any kind of discount and she wasn’t there. Was stressed to email her as the numbers on card would call the desk and would make it to her. I then set up the sofa bed for my kids and found out there was no bedding in the room for it. So went down and asked for it. When given the “bedding” I was given two blankets and a shower curtain. When I made it to the front desk to return the curtain for a sheet, both the gentleman and lady behind the counter seeemed annoyed I was back. But when I told them I wasn’t given a sheet, which they tried arguing I was showed them the shower curtain to which both of their jaws dropped.
I sent the manager and email and I will attach her replay to me. She told me that maintenance checked the room and the ac unit was satisfactory for the room.

If you want a room that has a chance to be warm for 7+ hours after arrival, with staff who can’t really do much to help other than just saying sorry then book here. There really wasn’t anything good about the hotel. I overheard multiple people complaining about their rooms and the lobby being warm. Just to to a different hotel and skip this one

Hello,
I am writing to formally complain about my stay at Extended Stay America Select Suites – Orlando – East.
On our very first morning, we woke up to find cockroaches all over the room. This was extremely disturbing and completely unacceptable. Despite reporting this immediately, we were not moved to another room until the following day.Later, when we requested clean towels at approximately 1PM, when we came back at 10PM a front desk employee named Cam refused service and stated towels were only available between 4–8 PM. Her attitude was extremely rude and dismissive.We also felt we were treated differently because we are Asian. This experience made us feel uncomfortable and disrespected.Between the unsanitary room conditions, delayed room change, refusal of basic amenities, and hostile staff behavior, this stay has caused significant distress. If this matter is not resolved promptly, I will proceed with filing complaints with the Orange County Health Department and consumer protection agencies.

text.text:
0/5 – Extremely disappointing experience

I stayed at Fairfield by Marriott Inn & Suites Orlando Ocoee from Tuesday, February 3rd, to Wednesday, February 4th. I chose this hotel because it is close to my workplace, since I travel very frequently from Miami to Ocoee.

Unfortunately, this was a terrible experience.
I accidentally left my favorite pair of sneakers (New Balance 1906R, size 7 ) in the room and called the hotel immediately the same day. I spoke with two front desk employees, and both told me that nothing was found and they had no explanation I called the next day also and they told me the same thing.

It is very hard to believe that my shoes simply disappeared the same day I checked out. The room had to be cleaned after my departure, and the lack of accountability makes me strongly believe that the person who clean after my check out took them. These were not just shoes, they were a very special gift from someone dear to me, which makes this situation even more upsetting.

This raises serious concerns about security and honesty. When guests choose a hotel, it’s because we trust that our belongings will be safe, even if something is accidentally left behind.

To make things worse, they also charge extra fees at check-in supposedly for insurance, yet the hotel feels old, not very comfortable, and does not meet the standards expected from a Marriott property.

I had a Holiday Inn just minutes away, and I regret not choosing it. I travel often, and I can confidently say I will never stay here again and would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

DO NOT STAY AT THIS HOTEL!!!
This place is absolutely disgusting and the management is running what feels like a complete scam operation. I checked in around 3:30 PM and left by 4:00 PM because the room was filthy and clearly had not been cleaned properly. The toilet seat was broken and hanging off the side, there was hair in the sink, shower, and even in the bed. The hallway smelled like dog urine, and even outside near the parking area the smell of overflowing trash was overwhelming. The pictures online are completely misleading and do not represent the condition of this property at all.

When I returned later that night around 10 PM and turned the lights on, me and my kids watched FOUR roaches scatter across the room. That was the final straw. There was no way we could stay in that unsanitary environment, especially with children.

To make matters even worse, after leaving the hotel early, they charged me for “damaged towels” that I NEVER even used. Since the room was so disgusting, I barely touched anything before leaving. Adrianna at the front desk claimed housekeeping reported damaged towels, but when I asked how they were damaged, she repeatedly said, “I don’t know.” She was rude, dismissive, and acted completely uninterested in helping resolve the issue.

I repeatedly asked to speak with a manager, and at first she acted like she didn’t even know who the manager was. Eventually she mentioned someone named Carlos, saying he usually comes in during the afternoon and would call me back. I left my number multiple times and never received a call. Every time I followed up, I got a different excuse — “he’s in a meeting,” “he’s unavailable,” or “he already left.”

After my THIRD attempt to speak with management, Carlos finally called me back — only to immediately start yelling at me on the phone asking why I kept calling. He told me he “owed me no explanation,” insisted I was going to pay for the towels, and then abruptly hung up on me. When I tried calling back, he repeatedly hung up on me or placed me on hold while saying, “I can do this all day.” I have honestly never experienced such rude, aggressive, and unprofessional behavior from hotel management in my life.

This hotel is dirty, poorly maintained, dishonest, and completely lacking any level of customer service or professionalism. Save yourself the stress, frustration, and health risk and stay somewhere else.
I wouldn't give it any stars if I didn't have to in order to post.

displayName.text: Hampton Inn by Hilton Ocoee Orlando

text.text:
Our stay at the Hampton Inn & Suites Ocoee was absolutely exceptional from start to finish. Every detail of this hotel felt elevated, polished, and thoughtfully maintained. The gym was spotless and modern, the laundry room was impressively clean and convenient, the pool area was beautiful and relaxing, and the breakfast area was one of the nicest we’ve experienced at any Hampton Inn; clean, inviting, and incredibly well kept.

What truly made this stay unforgettable, though, was the staff.

Miguel was beyond remarkable. He was friendly, knowledgeable, professional, and genuinely eager to help in every interaction we had with him. He anticipated needs before we even had to ask and made us feel completely valued as guests. His warm personality combined with his professionalism created the kind of hospitality that people remember long after their stay.

Damar also deserves special recognition for delivering outstanding customer service from the moment we arrived. He welcomed us with such a warm, upbeat, and friendly demeanor that we instantly felt at home. His positive attitude, attentiveness, and genuine kindness set the tone for our entire visit. Employees like Damar are rare and make a lasting impression.

It’s also very clear that Jonathan, the Front Office Manager, has cultivated a strong culture of excellence and hospitality throughout the team. The professionalism, attentiveness, and consistency among the staff did not go unnoticed. Leadership like his is reflected in every part of the guest experience.

This hotel exceeded expectations in every way. We will absolutely return and highly recommend this property to anyone visiting the area.

displayName.text: Home2 Suites by Hilton Winter Garden

text.text:
We had a wonderful stay at Home2 Suites in Winter Garden and couldn’t be happier with our experience. From the moment we arrived, the receptionist Kai was incredibly helpful, welcoming, and professional—such a great first impression, she even greeted us with a water bottle for each guest.

The room itself was spotless. We stayed in a queen bedroom suite, and it was truly phenomenal: clean, spacious, comfortable, and thoughtfully laid out. The beds and bedrooms were pristine, and everything felt fresh and well cared for.

The breakfast honestly deserves a special mention—it’s one of the best continental breakfasts I’ve had at a hotel in this category. Plenty of options, fresh fruit & yogurt, well organized, real plateware & silverware, what a great way to start the day.

We had an appointment at the medical center next door, and the location couldn’t have been more convenient, which made an already stressful day feel so much easier. Overall, our stay was seamless, comfortable, and truly enjoyable.

I wouldn’t hesitate to return, and after this experience, I’ll definitely be choosing Home2 Suites whenever possible going forward. Highly recommend!

Make sure to read the guidelines they give you at the time you check in because it has the answer to a lot of questions you'll need to know, like how to lock your door and how to turn the shower head on.
Don't forget to check the seating area at the end of the hallway, on the second floor.
Quaint place overall.
I'm not sure why there were a lot of "Jesus Saves" stickers everywhere...

text.text:
Small hiccup at check-in, room wasn’t ready. But once we got in the place was great. The staff went out of their way to make us feel welcome. Always smiling, always helpful. The cleaning staff made sure our room was perfect.

The breakfast was great; Eggs, Sausage, Bagels , Donuts, Waffles!!! Coffee was hot and juices were perfect.

The location was amazing, a bunch of nearby fast food chains, you could walk to Taco Bell or KFC, short drive to Chick-Fil-A & WayBack Burgers. So many other great options just down the road, including a ramen spot my wife loved Oodle Ramen. Plus Publix Supermarket for all your needs.

If you’re doing Universal it’s seriously a 5 minute drive to the Universal parking lot or a 10 minute drive to Epic.

We already booked a room here for our next trip and can’t wait. Great Value, Great Staff, Great Location!

text.text:
Wyndham Wingate near Universal
Easily found. Several casual dining places within walking distance. Convenience store and supermarket nearby. The room is setup with a microwave,  a coffee maker and a decent size refrigerator. The desk and couch area are in the middle then you have King Bed, and dresser. The bathroom wasn’t huge but was just enough for 1 person at a time and had a bathtub. This place is ideal for several days or several weeks.
The reception was quick and easy with advanced checkin, the hotel includes breakfast but wasn’t elaborate. It is probably one of the worst I’ve been to. The people refilling the food look like they don't care at all, the guests are like animals when they see there is a limited supply of something The eggs were inedible as many people took them but then threw them away. If you go at 7am sharp you can get out of it ok, but after that it’s a circus and almost a contact sport.
The wifi was good enough. The Hotel doesn’t seem new, but it is certainly well maintained. Laundry on 3rd floor worked well enough.
I might stay again but there are so many good options at same price point in same area. Windham status is not recognized like at a Marriott or IHG property, even Hilton does a better job at recognizing status.

text.text: Room 107 is filled with black mold in shower. Air quality is terrible. Dampness and the smell of bleach hits you as soon as you open the door. Black mold is present between bathroom shower tiles. Management does not care to address the issue and simply says no other guest has complained. I had runny nose, chest tighness and headache from being exposed to black mold. Will be following up with health inspection governing body of Florida. Finally got transferred to a different room on day 5 to room 416 and the difference was night and day! Air quality was good, no bleach smell, no dampness and no mold. Room 107 is a dissiabilty accessible room and maybe isnt rented out often? I don't know, but clearly staff including cleaning staff know about the mold as its the only room out of 107 and 416 that is having a heavy bleach smell. Will be following up with Hilton to let them know of this issue as this kind of standard and well as a dodging manager ( Manni) trying to not address the issue. We stayed 5 nights inhaling black mold spores and his offer of remediation was to offer one night's comp .  As a courtesy no less. Very condescending manager. I wouldn't stay here again. And if this is the standards that Hilton subscribes to, and is indicative of what to expect, I wouldn't stay at any Hilton. Certainly will be staying away from the budget tier of Spark Hilton. On a side note, the bagel bar offered two kinds of bagels, plain and everything, some cereal, watered down juices to the point of being coloured water. But the complimentary continental breakfast and its lackluster offerings were nothing compared to the having been exposed to inhaling black mold for 5 days with no possibility of changing rooms as the were sold out.  Will Never again stay  at a Spark Hilton. Hilton is really watering down their brand with thia kind of representation.

text.text: BEWARE OF THIS HOTEL! as a well traveled person, please listen to me when i say to stay literally anywhere else in the orlando area but this hotel. where do i begin… we killed multiple roaches in the hotel while staying there. flashback to before the stay, i booked this hotel months ago with expedia. i chose the pay at hotel option like i always do and it’s never given me any trouble. the night before our stay, i was randomly charged $200 over what my total was for the whole stay. i hadn’t even left for my trip yet. i called the hotel front desk, and the person who answered was so rude. he told me i had to be in the hotel by 11 pm or he’d cancel our whole reservation. meanwhile, other hotels i’ve stayed at have been very cooperative with kate flights and just make notes on the reservation. i explained that we didn’t even land in the city until midnight and then he started saying they had to go ahead and charge my card for the first night. i’ve stayed in 100+ hotels using expedia and i’ve never had this issue before. it almost felt like a scam even talking to him. i called hilton customer service and then weren’t much better unfortunately. they talked to me condescendingly basically seemed mad that i used expedia. for some reason, hilton had my stay as one extra night than i booked through expedia, so they had to change that. they also had my whole stay price wrong and then unfortunately i was forced to pay my first night fee. they told me i could pay the rest when i got there. imagine my surprise when i get on my plane and see that the hotel has charged the whole stay without me even being there. i’m not sure what the point of paying extra to pay at the hotel through expedia is if the hotels aren’t even going to honor it. i’ve never had this issue with a hotel ever. i’m shocked at the way this hotel just charges anything to your card that they want to at anytime and don’t even let you know in advance that they’re doing it. also, do yourself a favor a check reviews for this place on tripadvisor. there are so many stories of how this hotel has been nothing but sketchy. ignore the positive comments on this place they have to be like bots are something.
